scope: Exercise 4; target transformation only, no feature or hyperparameter changes

candidates.delta_lag1: z[d] = cnt[d] - cnt_lag_1[d]; prediction = predicted_z + cnt_lag_1[d]
candidates.delta_roll7: z[d] = cnt[d] - cnt_roll_7[d]; prediction = predicted_z + cnt_roll_7[d]
candidates.ratio_roll7: z[d] = cnt[d] / cnt_roll_7[d]; prediction = predicted_z * cnt_roll_7[d]

rationale: Separate the known recent demand level from the innovation or relative multiplier learned by a tree. Every offset/scale is strictly historical and available before the prediction day.
estimator: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=0, max_iter=300), identical to the untransformed control
feature_set: Existing 15-feature experimental pipeline; unchanged across candidates
selection_rule: Highest validation R2 among these three candidates; lower validation MAE breaks an exact tie. Report all candidate validation scores, including failures. No additional candidates or hyperparameter searches.
test_protocol: Commit the selected method before computing its test predictions, then evaluate that transformed model once. Earlier untransformed test scores have already been seen and are disclosed; they do not select the transformation.
canonical_metrics: Keep reports/metrics.json as the untransformed pipeline. Save this experiment separately.
